newsitem.title: UK: Verity in licence deal with NEC, seeks funds.
newsitem.headline: Verity in licence deal with NEC, seeks funds.

text.p: British electronics and musical instrument manufacturer Verity Group Plc said on Thursday it had sealed a first licence agreement for its NXT flat panel speaker technology through a deal with Japan's NEC Corp which will allow the electronics giant to build NXT speakers into its multi-media products.

In a statement, Verity said that its board had also decided to finance the next stage of NXT development and Mission loudspeaker manufacturing through a share placing and open offer to raise about 8.65 million stg net of expenses.
The company plans to issue about 25.57 million new shares at 36 pence per share.
It added that it was also in other licence negotiations with a number of major companies in Europe, the United States, Japan and South Korea.
The remainder of the proceeds of the offer are to be used to reduce overall gearing and to restor working capital in the original group businesses "so they can fund an anticipated recovery".
Verity's shares rose 3-3/4 pence to 43 pence in early trade.
